general.title: 1. 通用條款（所有使用者）
general.welcome: 歡迎使用 MyConnect。使用我們的服務即表示您同意這些條款。這些規則適用於所有人，無論您是與角色聊天還是創建角色。
general.ageRequirementBody: 您必須年滿 13 歲才能使用此服務。如果您未滿 18 歲，必須獲得父母/監護人的許可。

players.title: 2. 玩家條款
players.usageGuidelinesBody:
• 請尊重 AI 角色。
• 請勿將服務用於非法活動。
• 請勿試圖繞過安全過濾器。
players.contentHistoryBody: • 您的聊天記錄對您是私密的。
players.rightToRetainBody: 如果創作者刪除了您與之聊天的角色，您與該角色的聊天記錄將保留在您的帳戶中，因此您不會丟失您的記憶/故事。

creators.title: 3. 創作者條款
creators.characterCreationBody:
• 您對自己創建的角色負責。
• 角色不得違反我們的安全或內容政策（無仇恨言論、非法內容等）。
creators.deletionPolicyBody: • 您有權隨時從公共目錄中刪除您的角色。
creators.importantBody: 刪除角色不會刪除已經與之互動的玩家的聊天記錄。他們與您的角色的個人歷史記錄將保留在其私人檔案中。
creators.ipBody: • 您保留原創角色概念的所有權。發布即表示您授予 MyConnect 展示和促進與您的角色聊天的許可。

privacy.title: 4. 隱私與數據
privacy.body: 您的對話可能會被處理以改進我們的 AI 模型。請勿在聊天中分享敏感的個人資訊（如信用卡號或密碼）。

disclaimers.title: 5. 免責聲明與安全警告
disclaimers.notProfessionalBody: AI 角色僅供娛樂。他們不是醫生、律師或治療師。如果您處於危機中或需要專業幫助，請立即諮詢合格的人類專業人士。
disclaimers.aiBehaviorBody: AI 角色根據模式和您的輸入生成回應。他們可能會編造事實（“幻覺”）或只是為了保持對話而同意您的觀點。請勿依賴他們獲取事實資訊或做關鍵的人生決定。

termination.title: 6. 終止
termination.body: 我們保留暫停或終止違反這些條款、從事騷擾或濫用系統的帳戶的權利。

general.title: 1. General Terms (All Users)
general.welcome: Welcome to MyConnect. Using our service means you agree to these terms. These rules apply to everyone, whether you are chatting with a character or creating one.
general.ageRequirementBody: You must be at least 13 years old to use this service. If you are under 18, you must have permission from a parent or guardian.

players.title: 2. Player Terms
players.usageGuidelinesBody:
• Please treat AI characters with respect.
• Do not use the service for illegal activities.
• Do not attempt to bypass safety filters.
players.contentHistoryBody: • Your chat history is private to you.
players.rightToRetainBody: If a creator deletes a character you have chatted with, your chat history with that character will remain in your account so you don’t lose your memories/stories.

creators.title: 3. Creator Terms
creators.characterCreationBody:
• You are responsible for the characters you create.
• Characters must not violate our safety or content policies (no hate speech, illegal content, etc.).
creators.deletionPolicyBody: • You may remove your character from the public directory at any time.
creators.importantBody: Deleting a character does not delete chat histories that players have already created with that character. Their personal histories with your character will remain in their private profiles.
creators.ipBody: • You retain ownership of your original character concepts. By publishing, you grant MyConnect permission to display and promote chats with your character.

privacy.title: 4. Privacy & Data
privacy.body: Your conversations may be processed to improve our AI models. Do not share sensitive personal information (like credit card numbers or passwords) in chat.

disclaimers.title: 5. Disclaimers & Safety Notice
disclaimers.notProfessionalBody: AI characters are for entertainment purposes only. They are not doctors, lawyers, or therapists. If you are in crisis or need professional help, please seek a qualified human professional immediately.
disclaimers.aiBehaviorBody: AI characters generate responses based on patterns and your input. They may fabricate facts (“hallucinate”) or agree with you just to keep the conversation going. Do not rely on them for factual information or important life decisions.

termination.title: 6. Termination
termination.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or engage in harassment or abuse of the system.
